hook: U.S. agencies issued 71 product recalls in November 2026 alone.

sections.voiceover: U.S. agencies issued 71 product recalls in November 2026 alone.
The FDA also logged 44 medical device records, but how many pose serious health risks?
Actually, 12 of those FDA medical device recalls carry the dangerous Class I risk rating.
NHTSA campaigns hit a massive scale, impacting 870,255 total units. Overseas, the French safety database France RappelConso added 98 more product safety entries this November.
These 71 U.S. recall events highlight widespread product safety monitoring efforts.
